files.text:
story:
    id: divide-integers
    feature: calculator
    title: Divide integers
    as_a: Calculator User
    i_want: to divide two validated integers
    so_that: I can obtain their quotient or a zero-divisor error
    status: PLANNED
    acceptance_criteria:
        - id: 001-division
          description: The calculator must return 3 when dividing 6 by 2.
          steps:
            - given:
                - the dividend is "6"
                - the divisor is "2"
            - when:
                - the Calculator User divides the numbers
            - then:
                - the result is "3"
        - id: 002-division
          description: The calculator must return 3 when dividing 9 by 3.
          steps:
            - given:
                - the dividend is "9"
                - the divisor is "3"
            - when:
                - the Calculator User divides the numbers
            - then:
                - the result is "3"
        - id: 003-division
          description: The calculator must return 0 when dividing 0 by 2.
          steps:
            - given:
                - the dividend is "0"
                - the divisor is "2"
            - when:
                - the Calculator User divides the numbers
            - then:
                - the result is "0"
        - id: 004-division
          description: The calculator must exit 1 with stderr "Cannot divide by zero" and print no result when the divisor is zero.
          steps:
            - given:
                - the dividend is "6"
                - the divisor is "0"
            - when:
                - the Calculator User divides the numbers
            - then:
                - the command exits 1 with stderr "Cannot divide by zero" and prints no result
